title: Customs Notification Lifecycle and Regulatory Framework
summary: This consolidated thread tracks the systematic issuance, amendment, and revocation of customs notifications by the NBR. It documents the transition from the Customs Act, 1969 to the Customs Act, 2023, highlighting the use of SROs to manage tariff values, duty exemptions, and regulatory compliance, including integration with the VAT and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012.

evolution.regulatory_basis: Shifted from Customs Act 1969 to Customs Act 2023, often read in conjunction with the VAT and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012.
evolution.procedure: Increased use of retrospective effective dates, standardized revocation clauses, and NBR-led SRO issuance.

timeline.change: Initial batch of notifications issued to cancel, amend, or update existing customs duty and tariff value regulations.

Initial notification issuance under 1969 Act framework.
Formal amendment of existing 2014 notifications using 1969 Act powers.
Mass revocation of legacy notifications spanning 1995-2019 to streamline the regulatory framework.
Integration of Customs Act, 1969 with VAT and Supplementary Duty Act, 2012 for notification authority.
Extensive cleanup of notifications and implementation of new effective dates for fiscal year 2022-23.
